description: Shared facial-layer library (T-046, engine/scene/face_layer.h). 'channels': face channel -> candidate controls in order of preference; a candidate is one control or a list driven together (left + right). Names resolve per character through its expression map, else as morph names; the first candidate a character has is used, a character with none skips the channel. 'neutral': the living face's resting tunables, which emotion 'faceMotion' sections change while they play.
